scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace server"
scripts.build: npm run build:cpp && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.build:cpp: cmake -S cpp -B cpp/build && cmake --build cpp/build --config Release
scripts.test:cpp: cmake -S cpp -B cpp/build && cmake --build cpp/build --config Release && ctest --test-dir cpp/build -C Release --output-on-failure
